[UI GATE t5 — reviewer-flash] Findings from Impeccable critique + audit (verified live on headless Edge via CDP, desktop 1440/tablet 900/mobile 390+768 touch).

PASS (verified): F1 delete guard (click-only 6px slop, drag >6px no delete, Esc exits, toast undo restores, Del ignored in textarea) · F2 resize (8 handles, cursor per handle, east drag +25px moves x2 only, 1 undo per gesture, min 8px + edge clamp in code, touch hit area 44×44 corner-first) · F3 nudge (±1px, coord clamp on blur, W×H shown) · F4 postrender (dirty orange dashed + badge "chưa lưu", editor=Bản dịch+Gốc, add/reset/nav hidden) · F5 re-render (busy label "⏳ Đang render…" + disabled during flight, success toast, server persist verified) · F6 undo/redo · F7 loading/404/422 code paths · F8 keyboard map + INPUT/TEXTAREA guard · F9 no horizontal overflow at any breakpoint · F10 aria-pressed, toast role=status/alert, focus-visible, reduced-motion, canvas aria-label.

--- NEEDS FIX (gate does NOT pass yet) ---

[P1-1] Backspace key deletes the selected block — correction.js keydown 'case backspace:' triggers deleteBlockAt. Spec F8 maps ONLY Del to delete. In Firefox Backspace also = browser-back by default, so the block is deleted AND the page can navigate back (lost work). Fix: remove 'backspace' from the delete case; keep only 'delete'.

[P1-2] translate.html is missing <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0"> — the results page renders at 980px layout width on phones (measured docW=980 at 390px), so the new "✏️ Chỉnh sửa" button (35px tall in the 980 layout) scales down to ~14px effective on a 390px device — nearly untappable, and the whole results page is a zoomed-out desktop layout on mobile. F9 explicitly puts responsive in-sprint. Fix: add the viewport meta to translate.html head.

[P1-3] New touch controls below 44×44: editor-close 30×30, editor-toggle 35px, nudge buttons 34px, edit-btn 35px (all measured). The captain's directive enforces touch hit-area 44×44 (resize handles are compliant — good — but the general controls are not). Fix: bump the NEW controls (editor-close, editor-toggle, nudge-btn, edit-btn) to ≥44×44 CSS px hit areas (min-height/min-width 44px, or padding). Pre-existing toolbar buttons at 33px are P2 (spec says keep incumbent styles).

--- P2 (next pass) ---
[P2-1] .thumb-item is a clickable div with no role="button"/tabindex → not keyboard-focusable despite .thumb-item:focus-visible CSS existing (keyboard users can still switch via ←/→, workaround exists).
[P2-2] Contrast: dirty badge white on #ff9100 = 2.26:1 (9px, fails 4.5:1); .shortcuts #999 on white = 2.85:1; btn-delete white on #fd5c63 = 3.05:1.
[P2-3] toast-action "Hoàn tác" button is small (~28px tall) — low hit area for the undo affordance.

Please fix P1-1..3 in one round; I will re-confirm with one more screenshot batch (desktop+mobile) before passing the gate.
